summary: A fleet that answers one ask with nothing at all while going on selling exactly what the work behind it asked for. An offer query is a search on the shape asked for, so the marketplace here publishes a 200GB machine and returns nothing whatever to a Run reserving 900GB: no candidate, no refusal, no machine to be waiting behind. That is the strongest thing a fleet can say and it was the one wait nothing exempted. The patient ask arrives first and is told so, with the evidence beside the reason: no machine weighed, none that could hold it. Twelve minutes of waiting promote it past the class that arrives next, and the Run that arrives fits what this fleet sells. Everything the queue does next used to turn on a fleet that published nothing being read as a wait for capacity to come free: the ask kept the queue, the work behind it was ordered behind an ask nothing in the fleet even matches, and it stayed there for the twenty four hours the patient class allows while the machine it wanted went unsold. So the assertion is the second Run, and it is placed. The world half of this matters as much as the control-plane half. Both simulated worlds answer the shape they were asked about now, because a world that returned its whole inventory whatever anybody asked could state a fleet nobody can use and never a fleet that answers one ask with nothing while answering another with a machine, which is the shape production reaches through a shape-filtered search rather than through an empty fleet.
